fields.label: Location
fields.note: The board ships country/state/city/other_locations option lists inside the listing init data and applies them in the browser; no query parameter for them was observed (only ?q= and ?p=).

fields.label: Team
fields.note: Published as the 'teams' filter (option ids + counts, e.g. Engineering 11805, Sales 22006) in the same client-side filter object.

notes: whatfix.com/careers/ publishes 'See All Openings' -> whatfix101.recruiterbox.com -> 301 -> whatfix101.hire.trakstar.com, a 33-job Trakstar Hire board (25 per page, ?p=N). The only published query parameters are q (keyword, input name='q' inside the GET form .js-job-search-form) and p (page). Location and team facets are rendered from the page's inline filter init data (countries/states/cities/other_locations/teams/remote_options, remote_options empty) and applied client-side, so they are matched locally. Sorting is a client-side widget (js-sort-component) with no observed query parameter.
evidence: https://whatfix101.hire.trakstar.com/ (HTTP 200) -> <form method="GET" class="js-job-search-form"> with <input type="text" name="q" placeholder="Search from jobs below">; pagination is ?p=N
